guide.sign-in.title: Sign in to the program
guide.sign-in.why: So you open the program with your own account.
guide.sign-in.ok: The home page opens with your name.
guide.sign-in.5: You are now in the program.
guide.first-setup.title: Set up the shop the first time
guide.first-setup.why: So the program keeps the shop name and the owner account.
guide.first-setup.ok: You can sign in afterwards with the owner account.
guide.first-setup.2: Type the name customers should see in [[setup.shop]].
guide.first-setup.5: Type a [[f.password]] of at least 8 characters.
guide.first-setup.7: Setup is saved and the shop is ready.
guide.shop-settings.title: Shop details on the receipt
guide.shop-settings.why: So the shop name shows on the sales receipt.
guide.shop-settings.ok: The name is saved and will show on the receipt.
guide.add-user.title: Add a person to the shop
guide.add-user.why: So each person signs in with their own account and permissions.
guide.add-user.ok: The name appears in the list of people.
guide.add-user.6: Type a [[f.password]] of at least 8 characters.
guide.backup.title: Copy the shop data
guide.backup.why: So a copy of the data stays on this device.
guide.backup.ok: The new copy appears in the list.
guide.backup.4: The copy is saved on this device.
guide.home-today.title: Today's summary
guide.home-today.why: So you see today's sales and what needs doing.
guide.home-today.ok: The sales figure and the number of receipts are shown.
guide.home-today.2: Read the greeting at the top of the page.
guide.home-today.3: Read the sales figure and the number of receipts.
guide.home-today.4: This is your summary for the day.
guide.open-shift.title: Open the shift with starting cash
guide.open-shift.why: So the drawer starts with the cash that is in it. That amount is taken out of the safe.
guide.open-shift.ok: The shift is open and the float has left the safe balance.
guide.open-shift.mistake: Do not type 0 if there is cash in the drawer. If you were wrong before any sale, close the shift with the real amount. Write the reason in the note.
guide.open-shift.2: Count the cash in the drawer. Type the amount in [[cash.float]].
guide.open-shift.4: The shift has started. This amount is the drawer float.
guide.make-sale.title: Create a sales invoice
guide.make-sale.why: So the total and the change are calculated and the sale is saved.
guide.make-sale.ok: The invoice is saved. The drawer goes up by the cash total only.
guide.make-sale.mistake: Do not confirm if the amount received is less than the total. Give the customer the change. The drawer does not go up by the whole amount received.
guide.make-sale.3: Choose the product from the results.
guide.make-sale.4: Press [[pos.pay]]. The pay screen opens and shows the total.
guide.make-sale.5: Type what you received from the customer in [[pos.received]]. It may be more than the total.
guide.make-sale.6: Read the number in [[pos.change]]. This is the cash you give back.
guide.collect-instalment.title: Collect an instalment from the customer
guide.collect-instalment.why: So the customer's debt goes down and the cash enters the drawer.
guide.collect-instalment.ok: The balance owed went down and the drawer went up.
guide.collect-instalment.mistake: Do not collect more than what is owed. A cash collection needs an open shift.
guide.collect-instalment.2: Open the customer who owes money, or the list of instalments due.
guide.collect-instalment.3: Press [[cust.collect]] next to the instalment or the customer's name.
guide.collect-instalment.4: Type the instalment in [[f.amount]]. Do not go above what is owed.
guide.collect-instalment.5: Press [[cust.collect]] after you check the amount.
guide.collect-instalment.6: The collection is saved and the debt went down.
guide.record-expense.title: Record an expense from the drawer
guide.record-expense.why: So the drawer goes down by money that left, with a clear reason.
guide.record-expense.ok: The expense shows in the drawer movements and the expected cash went down.
guide.record-expense.mistake: Write a reason of at least 3 characters. Without it the expense is not saved. Do not record it twice.
guide.record-expense.3: Type the expense amount in [[f.amount]]. Do not type 0.
guide.record-expense.4: Type what the money was for in [[cash.forWhat]].
guide.record-expense.6: The amount has left the drawer.
guide.read-shift.title: Read the shift total
guide.read-shift.why: So you know the cash expected in the drawer before you close.
guide.read-shift.ok: You know the amount that should be in the drawer.
guide.read-shift.mistake: Do not add card sales to the cash in the drawer. Those sales are not in the drawer.
guide.read-shift.2: Read the number under [[cash.inDrawer]]. This is what should be in the drawer.
guide.read-shift.3: In: starting cash, cash sales and instalments collected. Out: expenses, cash refunds and cash moved to the safe.
guide.read-shift.4: If the number matches your count, you can close.
guide.safe-move.title: Deposit money in the safe
guide.safe-move.why: So the safe balance goes up by new money you added.
guide.safe-move.ok: The safe balance went up and the drawer did not go down.
guide.safe-move.mistake: A deposit does not take cash from the drawer. To move drawer cash into the safe, use [[cash.drop]]. If the amount was wrong, reverse the entry. Write why you reversed it.
guide.safe-move.6: The safe balance went up by this amount.
guide.close-shift.title: Close the shift and count the drawer
guide.close-shift.why: So the counted cash matches the expected cash. After that, the cash goes to the safe.
guide.close-shift.ok: The result is shown: expected, counted and the difference.
guide.close-shift.mistake: Do not copy the expected number. Type what you counted. If a difference remains, write what happened in the note.
guide.close-shift.3: Count the cash in the drawer. Type what you found in [[cash.counted]].
guide.close-shift.4: Read [[cash.difference]]. If it is not zero, write the reason in [[cash.closeNote]]. The reason needs at least 3 characters.
guide.close-shift.6: The shift is closed. All the counted cash moved to the safe.
guide.take-return.title: Record a sale return
guide.take-return.why: So the item comes back and the money is refunded at the sale price after the discount.
guide.take-return.ok: The return is saved, and cash left the drawer if you refunded cash.
guide.take-return.mistake: Do not type a quantity above what is left on the invoice. Choose the item condition. A cash refund needs an open shift that holds enough.
guide.take-return.2: Open the invoice the customer is returning from.
guide.take-return.4: Type the reason for the return in [[f.reason]]. Write at least 3 characters.
guide.take-return.6: The return is saved. The amount is the sale price after the discount.
guide.read-reports.title: Read the sales reports
guide.read-reports.why: So you see the period's sales, expenses and returns.
guide.read-reports.ok: The figures for the period you chose are shown.
guide.read-reports.2: Look at the period bar at the top of the page.
guide.read-reports.3: Read net sales, expenses and returns. You can change the period from the bar.
guide.read-reports.4: These are the figures for the period on screen.
guide.read-stock.title: Look up how many you have
guide.read-stock.why: So you know how many of this item are available.
guide.read-stock.ok: The quantity appears next to the product name.
guide.read-stock.3: Read the quantity next to the product name.
guide.receive-goods.title: Receive goods from a supplier
guide.receive-goods.why: So the quantity of the item in the store goes up.
guide.receive-goods.ok: The quantity went up and the receipt shows in the list.
guide.receive-goods.mistake: Do not pay more than the invoice total. If some money is still unpaid, choose the supplier.
guide.receive-goods.3: Add at least one product. Type the quantity and the purchase price.
guide.receive-goods.5: The receipt is saved and the quantity went up.
problem.sign-in-wrong.why: The sign-in name or the password is wrong. Or the account is switched off. Or there were too many wrong tries. Or the recovery code is wrong.
problem.sign-in-wrong.do.1: Type the sign-in name in [[f.username]] again.
problem.sign-in-wrong.still: If the account is switched off, ask the owner to turn it on. If there were too many tries, wait a little and sign in again. If the owner forgot the password, press [[auth.forgot]] and type the [[recover.code]] from the printed paper.
problem.password-weak.see: The password or the discount limit was refused.
problem.password-weak.why: The password is short, easy, or the same as the sign-in name. Or the discount limit is not a number from 0 to 100.
problem.password-weak.do.1: Type a password of at least 8 characters.
problem.password-weak.do.2: Do not make it the same as the sign-in name.
problem.password-weak.do.3: Make the discount limit a number from 0 to 100.
problem.password-weak.still: Choose a password that only the account owner knows.
problem.people-guard.see: The person or the permissions profile was not saved.
problem.people-guard.why: The sign-in name is already used or incomplete. Or you cannot switch off the last manager or your own account.
problem.people-guard.do.1: Choose a sign-in name that is not already used.
problem.people-guard.do.2: Choose a permissions profile that exists.
problem.people-guard.still: Do not switch yourself off. Do not switch off the last person who manages people.
problem.no-permission.why: Your account does not have this permission.
problem.no-permission.do.1: Ask the owner to grant the permission.
problem.no-permission.still: The owner changes the permission from [[nav.settings]].
problem.practice-shop.see: Practice does not start, or says it is available in the practice shop only.
problem.practice-shop.why: The exercises run only inside the practice shop, a separate program with made-up data. It has not started yet, another program is using its place, or its made-up accounts are missing.
problem.practice-shop.do.1: Open [[nav.help]] in your real shop, press [[tr.openBtn]], then enter from the link that appears.
problem.practice-shop.do.2: If it says another program is using the place, close that program and try again.
problem.practice-shop.do.3: If it says the accounts are missing, sign in to the practice shop as owner, open [[nav.help]] and press [[tr.resetBtn]].
problem.practice-shop.still: Your real shop is not affected by any of this. Send us a message from Settings if it keeps failing.
problem.licence-locked.see: The licence does not allow saving.
problem.licence-locked.why: The licence code is missing, expired, or for another device.
problem.licence-locked.do.3: Press [[lic.req.trial]] and the code reaches the program and switches it on by itself.
problem.licence-locked.do.4: If the request does not work, copy the device code, send it to the company on Telegram, then paste the code.
problem.licence-locked.still: Ask the licence holder for a new code if it is still refused.
problem.bad-request.see: The request could not be done.
problem.bad-request.why: A number, a date or a field is not valid.
problem.bad-request.do.1: Correct the field that the message points to.
problem.bad-request.do.2: Write amounts with the digits 0 to 9.
problem.bad-request.still: If the date is in the past or incomplete, choose a valid day.
problem.data-busy.why: Another program is using the shop data file for a moment. It may be a database viewer, a copy program or an antivirus scan.
problem.data-busy.do.1: Wait a few seconds and press the button again.
problem.data-busy.do.2: Close any other program that opens the shop data.
problem.data-busy.still: If it happens again, close the program and open it again from its icon. What the screen already confirmed is saved.
problem.setup-done.why: The shop is already set up and setup is not done again.
problem.setup-done.do.1: Go back to the sign-in page.
problem.setup-done.do.2: Sign in with the owner account.
problem.setup-done.still: If the password was forgotten, the owner is the one who changes it.
problem.backup-bad.why: The file is damaged or it is not a copy of this shop.
problem.backup-bad.do.1: Choose another copy from the list.
problem.backup-bad.still: Do not restore a copy from another shop. Your current data will be replaced.
problem.no-shift.see: The shift does not allow this movement.
problem.no-shift.why: A sale, an expense, an instalment collection and a cash refund need an open shift. Or the shift is already open. Or it is closed.
problem.no-shift.still: If the shift is already open, do not open a second one. If it is closed, open a new shift with the cash that is in the drawer.
problem.drawer-diff.see: The amount does not match what is expected, or it is not enough.
problem.drawer-diff.why: The counted cash differs from the cash expected in the drawer. Or the amount asked for is more than the drawer or the safe holds.
problem.drawer-diff.do.1: Count the cash in the drawer again.
problem.drawer-diff.do.2: When you close, write why it differs in [[cash.closeNote]].
problem.drawer-diff.do.3: Lower the withdrawal, the expense or the refund until the drawer or the safe can cover it.
problem.drawer-diff.still: A common cause: the change you gave was wrong. Or an expense was not recorded. Or the starting cash was wrong. Card sales do not enter the drawer.
problem.cash-form.see: The cash movement was not saved.
problem.cash-form.why: The amount, the reason, the expense type or the source is missing. Or the movement was already reversed.
problem.cash-form.do.1: Type the amount in [[f.amount]]. Do not type 0.
problem.cash-form.do.2: Type what it was for in [[cash.forWhat]], at least 3 characters.
problem.cash-form.do.3: Choose the drawer or the safe if a source is asked for.
problem.cash-form.still: A sale, a return and a collection are reversed from their own page. Do not reverse the same movement twice.
problem.sale-lines.see: The sales invoice was not saved.
problem.sale-lines.why: There is no product. Or the payment does not equal the total. Or the discount is bigger than the total. Or the product has no price or is hidden. Or that way of paying is turned off.
problem.sale-lines.do.3: Read the change in [[pos.change]] before you confirm.
problem.sale-lines.still: If the product is hidden, show it from the products page. If the discount is above the total, lower it. If that way of paying is turned off, take cash, or ask the owner to turn it on in [[nav.settings]].
problem.sale-serial.why: The number is missing, repeated on the invoice, or not in the selling place.
problem.sale-serial.do.1: Choose the number written on the piece that is in the shop.
problem.sale-serial.still: If the number does not appear, move the piece to the selling place first.
problem.sale-approval.see: This sale needs a manager's approval.
problem.sale-approval.why: The discount or the return is above your limit. Or you cannot approve your own work.
problem.sale-approval.do.1: Ask another manager to approve it.
problem.sale-approval.still: If the discount is also above the manager's limit, lower the discount.
problem.sale-customer.see: The instalment or credit details are incomplete.
problem.sale-customer.why: A credit sale needs a customer and a large enough down payment. Or nothing is left to finance. Or the total changed.
problem.sale-customer.do.1: Choose the customer before you finish paying.
problem.sale-customer.do.2: Raise the down payment until it reaches the minimum.
problem.sale-customer.still: If nothing is left after the down payment, do not open an instalment plan. If a shop-floor place is required, add it from [[nav.settings]].
problem.return-problem.why: The quantity is more than what is left on the invoice. Or the item condition was not chosen.
problem.return-problem.do.1: Type a quantity that is not above what can be returned.
problem.return-problem.do.2: Choose good, so it goes back to the shelf, or damaged, so it goes to repair.
problem.return-problem.still: The refund is the sale price after the discount. A cash refund leaves the drawer, so do not refund more than it holds.
problem.stock-short.why: The quantity is not enough in this place. Or the place is not for selling. Or a stock count is still open.
problem.stock-short.do.2: Move the goods to the shop floor before you sell them.
problem.stock-short.still: If a stock count is open, finish it before any movement. When you transfer, choose two different places.
problem.receive-problem.see: The goods receipt was not saved.
problem.receive-problem.why: The amount paid is more than the supplier invoice total. Or some money is still unpaid and no supplier is chosen.
problem.receive-problem.do.1: Make the amount paid less than the total, or equal to it.
problem.receive-problem.do.2: Choose the supplier if some money is still unpaid.
problem.receive-problem.still: With no supplier, the receipt is recorded as opening stock only, and no debt remains.
problem.customer-problem.see: The customer details or the instalment were refused.
problem.customer-problem.why: The phone is already used, or the national ID is not 14 digits. Or the collection is more than what is owed, or more than what is left on the instalment plan. Or the number of months or the first due date is not valid.
problem.customer-problem.do.1: Correct the phone to a number that is not already used.
problem.customer-problem.do.2: Keep the collection within what is owed.
problem.customer-problem.do.3: Set the first instalment on a day that has not come yet.
problem.customer-problem.still: The national ID is 14 digits. Do not collect more than the customer owes, or more than you owe a supplier.
problem.product-problem.see: The product or its price was not saved.
problem.product-problem.why: The code, the price, the unit or the quantity is not valid. Or the minimum price is above the selling price.
problem.product-problem.do.1: Correct the field that the message points to.
problem.product-problem.do.2: Make the selling price higher than the minimum price.
problem.product-problem.still: Write the price, the quantity and the amount with digits from 0 to 9.
problem.support-problem.why: The support address or its code is missing or not valid.
problem.support-problem.do.1: Type the full support address. It starts with https.
problem.support-problem.still: Ask the support team for the address and the code.
problem.reason-needed.see: The program asks for a reason.
problem.reason-needed.why: Reversing a movement, closing a stock count, or a return needs a clear reason.
problem.reason-needed.do.1: Write what happened, in at least 3 characters.
problem.reason-needed.still: Name the difference or the mistake. Do not leave the reason empty.
problem.watch-page.see: The owner's eye shows shop alerts.
problem.watch-page.why: A drawer difference, a large expense and other alerts show here.
problem.watch-page.still: This page is for the owner and anyone who has its permission.
